Caleb Williams) played only the opening series. Williams went 2-of-5, and BOTH completions were tight-end/WR: **Loveland (1 catch, 10 yds) and Odunze (1 catch, 18 yds)** — Williams also missed Loveland on a potential TD in the red zone on that same series. **Cole Kmet did not draw a target in the sample.** Read against the row's own 8/16 falsifiable trigger ("If Loveland does not clearly out-target Kmet with the ones, DEMOTE at the next sweep"): in the one series the starters played, Loveland clearly out-targeted Kmet (1 target + a near-TD vs. zero) — the trigger fired POSITIVE, not negative. Sample is tiny (one drive, five pass attempts) — directional confirm, not season-defining — and preseason Wk3 is very likely another starters-rest week (Ben Johnson has sat starters, or played them one series, in both Wk1 and Wk2), so this may be the last real data point before the draft. **Still NOT demoted**: field still at TE3/#37 vs the claim of overall TE1, no lead time to measure yet — demoting would still be premature. HOLD Active. What survives and is current: Loveland starred in the first fan-attended practice (4 catches in the two-minute period) and **Caleb Williams said he 'can become the best tight end in the league'** ([247Sports](https://247sports.com/nfl/chicago-bears/article/ahead-of-pivotal-year-two-colston-loveland-making-big-strides-in-chicago-bears-training-camp--288601899/)).* **·· PRESEASON WK1 FOLD 2026-08-16 ··** **HOLD in Active — run A decided against the requested demote, and the reasoning is the point.** The D.J. The gap between claim and price is unchanged, so there is **no lead time to measure**, and demoting would corrupt the audit ledger the Consensus section exists to protect. **New situational leg replacing the dead one:** Ben Johnson intends **13-personnel with all three TEs on the field** — Chicago ran **94 three-TE snaps in 2025, 5th in the NFL** ([Sun-Times](https://chicago.suntimes.com/bears/2026/08/04/bears-coach-ben-johnson-now-has-3-premium-talents-at-tight-end-and-his-offense-is-about-to-get-wild) **pub 2026-08-04**).
